notes:
PDF is 2 pages. Page 1 contains the full major-map table (Semesters One through Eight); page 2 is Graduation Requirements Summary, Program Notes, and the Codes legend, which per instructions is excluded from sections.

Row-count note: this document has exactly the ENGL 101 case the task description warns about -- "ENGL 101 Critical Reading and Composition 3 C CC-CMW" -- title and the credit value "3" are separated by only one space with no other delimiter, which is why a naive regex parser can swallow or drop this row. Confirmed by eye it is present, not critical, 3 credits, min grade C, code CC-CMW, no prerequisite.

Stacked/multi-line Code cells: two rows have two code values printed on separate lines within one cell rather than joined by a slash in print (ENGL 102: "CC-CMW" then "CC-INF" on the next line; CSCE 490: "MR" then "CC-INT" on the next line). I recorded these as slash-joined strings ("CC-CMW/CC-INF" and "MR/CC-INT") to match the convention illustrated in the task instructions ("MR/CC-INT" example). By contrast, two other rows print the slash literally in-line in the source ("CC/PR" for the two "Carolina Core GFL... or Elective7" rows, and "PR/MR" for one Semester Eight elective) -- those are transcribed exactly as printed, no interpretation needed.

The table has a "Program GPA" column (marked with "*" for many CSCE/MATH courses that count toward the major GPA) between Min. Grade and Code. There is no field for this in the requested row schema, so that marker is intentionally not captured anywhere -- flagging in case a parser is expected to account for it elsewhere.

The rightmost "Notes" column is blank for every single row on page 1; nothing was lost by the schema not having a per-row notes field.

Several rows wrap across 2-3 printed lines and were joined with single spaces per instructions, most notably: CSCE 190 and CSCE 146 prerequisite cells (2-3 lines each), CSCE 330/CSCE 492/CSCE 490 titles (course name + italic "fall only"/"spring only" on the next line), and the ENGL 462/463 alternative-course row (two course lines merged into one row because they share a single credits/code/prerequisite set).

Footnote digits were kept fused to titles exactly as printed and not treated as course/credit data: "Calculus 13", "AIU4", "SCI4", "CMS4", "GSS4", "GFL4", "Elective7", "GFL8", "Major Elective6", "GHS8", "Requirement5".

total_credits_required ("120") was taken from the page-2 Graduation Requirements Summary table ("Minimum Total Hours") since it is a program-level field, not a section row; the summary table itself was otherwise excluded per instructions.
